economy_pack_versions_published_complete.name: economy_pack_versions_published_complete
economy_pack_versions_published_complete.value:
"economy_pack_versions"."status" = 'draft' OR (
        "economy_pack_versions"."effective_from" IS NOT NULL AND "economy_pack_versions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "economy_pack_versions"."published_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND "economy_pack_versions"."publish_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("economy_pack_versions"."publish_reason")) > 0
        AND "economy_pack_versions"."effective_from" >= "economy_pack_versions"."published_at"
      )

paid_actions_refund_by_status.name: paid_actions_refund_by_status
paid_actions_refund_by_status.value:
("paid_actions"."status" = 'refunded') = ("paid_actions"."refund_transaction_id" is not null)
        and ("paid_actions"."refund_transaction_id" is null or "paid_actions"."settlement_transaction_id" is not null)

paid_actions_price_pinned.name: paid_actions_price_pinned
paid_actions_price_pinned.value:
("paid_actions"."price_source" = 'ruleset') = ("paid_actions"."ruleset_id" is not null)
        and ("paid_actions"."ruleset_id" is not null) = ("paid_actions"."ruleset_version" is not null)
        and ("paid_actions"."price_source" = 'ruleset') = ("paid_actions"."price_ref_id" is null)

subscription_history_previous_complete.name: subscription_history_previous_complete
subscription_history_previous_complete.value: ("subscription_history"."previous_plan_version_id" IS NULL) = ("subscription_history"."previous_status" IS NULL) AND ("subscription_history"."previous_status" IS NULL) = ("subscription_history"."previous_period_end" IS NULL)

wallet_transactions_direction_by_type.name: wallet_transactions_direction_by_type
wallet_transactions_direction_by_type.value:
("wallet_transactions"."entry_type" in ('grant', 'reward', 'purchase', 'refund', 'release') and "wallet_transactions"."direction" = 'credit')
        or ("wallet_transactions"."entry_type" in ('paid_action', 'hold', 'capture') and "wallet_transactions"."direction" = 'debit')
        or "wallet_transactions"."entry_type" in ('reversal', 'admin_adjustment')
